findings.current: If it had been an hour ago, I might not even have heard Jeok Cheongang’s voice.
findings.defect: An hour changes the stated interval.
findings.rationale: 한 식경 is half an hour.
findings.replacement: If it had been half an hour ago, I might not even have heard Jeok Cheongang’s voice.
findings.source: 아마 한 식경 전이었다면 적천강의 목소리조차 듣지 못했을 것이다.

findings.current: Temur jabbed Chinggen in the waist, shaking his head, then raised his cup high and called out:
findings.defect: The draft assigns the head-shaking to Temur instead of Chinggen.
findings.rationale: 칭겐 is the one shaking his head; Temur jabs him and raises the cup.
findings.replacement: Temur jabbed the head-shaking Chinggen in the waist, then raised his cup high and called out:
findings.source: 고개를 절레절레 내젓는 칭겐의 허리춤을 쿡 찌른 테무르가 손에 쥔 술잔을 높이 치켜세우며 외쳤다.

findings.current: A cold wind carrying sand whipped through the entrance of the ger.
findings.defect: The wind pushes the entrance open in the source; the draft instead has it pass through.
findings.rationale: 입구를 밀어젖혔다 describes opening the entrance, not merely blowing through it.
findings.replacement: A cold wind carrying sandy dust pushed open the entrance to the ger.
findings.source: 모래 먼지를 머금은 차가운 바람이, 게르의 입구를 밀어젖혔다.

findings.current: “May you live out your days in good health!”
findings.defect: The blessing substitutes good health for long life.
findings.rationale: 천수를 누리다 wishes someone their full natural lifespan; it does not specify good health.
findings.replacement: “May you live to a ripe old age!”

summary: Four actionable findings: a time quantity, two physical actions, and a blessing are changed.
